title: maintainer-action(ui-merge): after #27145, move objectui.org and www.objectui.org onto the objectstack Vercel project and delete the Vercel project `objectui` (rescoped: objectui.org folds into objectstack docs)
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). In the "Restore objectui.org docs deploy" project thread on 2026-10-28 02:14Z, after #27005 merged, Tesla wrote: 「立一张维护者操作卡，实际没这么简单，因为 vercel 中挂的项目也要改。」

**Rescoped 2026-10-28.** At 03:24Z, in the same thread, Tesla chose 「B 并入 objectstack 文档站」: www.objectui.org stops being a separate site. At 07:58Z Tesla confirmed the page evaluation with 「VS Code 扩展 不会发布，其他同意」 and 「你负责派卡执行」. The fold is #27140, #27141, #27142 and #27145. #27145 deletes `ui/apps/site` and the `deploy-ui-site` job, and adds host-based 301s from objectui.org to objectstack.ai/docs.

So the Vercel project `objectui` no longer needs reconfiguring; it needs retiring. The original seven-item reconfiguration checklist is void, and this card's maintainer action shrinks to moving the domains and then deleting the project.

Blocked-by: #27145

Maintainer-action: after #27145 merges, move the domains `objectui.org` and `www.objectui.org` from the Vercel project `objectui` (`prj_v1rXIczaI7YGmXmseQCLFUFOFxTB`) to the Vercel project `objectstack` (`prj_KbPkuEVCj8viErlaC0wBUgMIYZWe`), confirm one old URL answers 301, then delete the project `objectui`. Done when `curl -sI https://www.objectui.org/docs/guide/quick-start` answers 301 to an objectstack.ai/docs/frontend page, recorded on #26993.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:本卡不改代码。原来的 7 项 Vercel 重新配置作废,因为你选了把 objectui.org 并入 objectstack 文档站,这个 Vercel 项目以后不用了。
- **为什么改**:#27145 合并后,objectstack 文档站会按 host 识别 objectui.org 的请求,把每个旧路径 301 到新位置。前提是这两个域名挂在 objectstack 的 Vercel 项目上,这一步只有你能在控制台做。
- **风险与回滚**:域名挪过去之前,www.objectui.org 继续显示合并前最后一次部署的旧站,不会更糟。挪过去之后如果跳转有问题,把域名挪回 `objectui` 项目即可恢复;所以删项目放在确认跳转正常之后。
- **先看**:等 #27145 合并,本卡在那之前不需要动。
- **两分钟验证**:域名挪好后,浏览器打开 https://www.objectui.org/docs/guide/quick-start,应跳到 objectstack.ai/docs/frontend 下的快速开始页。
- **需要你做的**:#27145 合并后,在 Vercel 控制台挪两个域名,确认跳转,再删项目 `objectui`。

## Steps (Vercel dashboard)

1. Project `objectui` → Settings → Domains: remove `www.objectui.org` and `objectui.org`.
2. Project `objectstack` → Settings → Domains: add both. Vercel shows the DNS records. If the domains already point at Vercel, as they do today, nothing changes at the registrar.
3. Open https://www.objectui.org/docs/guide/quick-start and check that it lands on the SDK quick start under objectstack.ai/docs/frontend.
4. Delete the project `objectui` (Settings → Advanced → Delete Project).

## Who acts

The maintainer, in the Vercel dashboard, after #27145 merges. The seat then records the 301 on #26993 and closes #26993 and this card.

**Business reason.** Every link to www.objectui.org keeps working: npm package pages, READMEs, search results and old issues. Paying for and watching a second Vercel project stops.

**Duplicate search.** objectstack-ai/objectstack, "vercel objectui project root directory git repository maintainer action objectui.org": 12 hits, the first 10 read: #26993 (open; this card's parent work) and nine closed ui-merge cards (#25677, #25678, #25685, #25723, #25726, #25728, #25752, #25854, #25151). None covers the Vercel project. **New.**

**Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
